payload.title: Auth: email signup/login + forgot/reset password + refresh tokens
payload.description: Only /auth/signup,login,dev-login,logout are ported. Missing (src/server.ts:1181+): /auth/email/signup, /auth/email/login, /auth/email/forgot-password, /auth/email/reset-password (auth_password_reset_tokens store, migrated), /auth/refresh + /auth/refresh/revoke (auth_refresh_tokens store, migrated). Shares the auth-attempt limiter. forgot/reset is the consumer making outbound email non-dead-code. Carry over FR-217/218/219 auth-core audit fixes.
